inherited_constraints: Use only immutable public inputs bound by this run and durable state from this assigned run-state path.

verification_boundaries: Each experiment request must name an experiment from the bound public fixture catalog.

Independent critic and synthesizer are separate fresh role invocations and are not performed by this decomposer.
